scope: Original adult nonsexual body artwork and supported local layer recipes; separate from main game.
inspection: Full figures reviewed on opaque light and dark boards; native PNGs and local gallery also inspected.
Thin brown contours, matte palette and controlled cel shadows retained.
Shoulder continuity, hand/body overlap, alpha edges, baseline and skin recoloring inspected.
Every chest size/shape appears in a composed fit proof; both sexes, gestures and all eight palettes covered.
Nine abdominal stages have strictly increasing rendered foreground area with the same body/frame.
limits: 48 selected recipes are a coverage sample, not an exhaustive test of the Cartesian product.
Extreme width and gesture combinations can have pronounced stylized shoulder contours; inspect at the intended game scale before integration.
Heads are reference guides. Individual faces, hairstyles, underwear and seasonal wardrobe are separate packs.
Pregnancy states use their own volume and pose; the compositor rejects incompatible chest, muscle, leg and gesture replacements.
Anthro body/coat/tail bases are standalone; complete human-rig interoperability and final species faces are not claimed.
Body LoRA is accepted only for checked reference-preserving edits, not arbitrary free pose generation.
No in-engine or existing save migration was performed.
counting: Source edits, reference reuse, proportion derivatives, material variants and composed examples are separate. Quantitative category coverage does not establish universal artistic superiority over School.
